# Values brand heritage and first-of-its-kind movements

David cares most about provenance — a manufacturer with real history and an
in-house movement that broke new ground when it launched. He'd take a
heritage piece with a landmark calibre over a newer watch with better specs.
"Firsts" matter to him: the original of a kind beats the refinement.
